g.text: Green: account use cases implemented in stage 04. Yellow: welcome-only notification/email subset.
Other use cases remain planned; health is outside this business diagram.
Every protected use case requires server-side role, ownership and active-account checks.
ADMIN cannot book or read chats; organizer chat initiation requires a current/past booking.
[S] is optional. System S1-S7 are mandatory use-case IDs.
Q-01 through Q-05 remain open; no proposed business resolution is approved here.
